scripts.start: npm run build && npm run build:worker && node scripts/start.mjs
scripts.build: node scripts/package-extension.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build --configLoader runner
scripts.test: node scripts/test.mjs && node tests/schema.mjs && node scripts/web-tests.mjs
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/test.mjs --compile-only && npm run build:worker && node scripts/integration.mjs && node scripts/coverage-test.mjs && node scripts/auth-test.mjs && node scripts/session-test.mjs && node scripts/durable-work-test.mjs
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env local
scripts.db:seed: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --env local --file seed.sql
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run build:worker && wrangler deploy
scripts.check:deploy: npm run build && npm run build:worker && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir work/deploy-check
